     1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""OCR (alibaba/open-code-review) reviewer vendor adapter.
     3	
     4	Runs ``ocr review`` over the current worktree's diff and rewrites its
     5	``comments[]`` into a review-findings payload on stdout. See
     6	``openspec/changes/add-deterministic-review-preprocessing/contracts/
     7	ocr-adapter.md`` for the full command and output-rewrite contract.
     8	
     9	Discovered as an optional Tier-1 reviewer vendor only when the ``ocr``
    10	binary is on PATH and an LLM endpoint is configured — see
    11	:func:`can_dispatch`. Absent either, the adapter exits 2 and dispatch treats
    12	the vendor as unavailable, the standard Tier-3 skip; nothing else about
    13	dispatch changes.
    14	"""
    15	
    16	from __future__ import annotations
    17	
    18	import argparse
    19	import json
    20	import os
    21	import shutil
    22	import subprocess
    23	import sys
    24	import tempfile
    25	from pathlib import Path
    26	from typing import Any
    27	
    28	
    29	def ocr_configured() -> bool:
    30	    """True when ``ocr`` has an LLM endpoint configured (env or config file)."""
    31	    if os.environ.get("OCR_LLM_URL") or os.environ.get("OCR_LLM_TOKEN"):
    32	        return True
    33	    config_path = Path.home() / ".opencodereview" / "config.json"
    34	    return config_path.is_file()
    35	
    36	
    37	def can_dispatch() -> bool:
    38	    """True when the ``ocr`` binary is on PATH and it is configured."""
    39	    return shutil.which("ocr") is not None and ocr_configured()
    40	
    41	
    42	def _rewrite_comment(comment: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    43	    """Rewrite one OCR comment into a review-findings finding fragment.
    44	
    45	    ``category`` becomes both ``type`` and ``axis`` (coercion maps the same
    46	    source string through separate alias tables). ``severity`` becomes
    47	    ``criticality`` directly — OCR's four severities are spelled identically
    48	    to our ``criticality`` enum — and the finding's own ``severity`` is left
    49	    absent so the standard criticality-to-severity coercion fills it.
    50	    """
    51	    category = comment.get("category") or "other"
    52	    finding: dict[str, Any] = {
    53	        "id": index,
    54	        "type": category,
    55	        "criticality": comment.get("severity") or "low",
    56	        "description": comment.get("content") or "",
    57	        "disposition": "fix",
    58	        "axis": category,
    59	        "file_path": comment.get("path"),
    60	    }
    61	    existing_code = comment.get("existing_code")
    62	    if existing_code:
    63	        finding["existing_code"] = existing_code
    64	    start = comment.get("start_line") or 0
    65	    end = comment.get("end_line") or 0
    66	    if start and end:
    67	        finding["line_range"] = {"start": start, "end": end}
    68	    suggestion = comment.get("suggestion_code")
    69	    if suggestion:
    70	        finding["resolution"] = f"Suggested change:\n{suggestion}"
    71	    return finding
    72	
    73	
    74	def rewrite_output(
    75	    ocr_result: dict[str, Any], *, change_id: str, review_type: str,
    76	) -> dict[str, Any]:
    77	    """Rewrite a parsed ``ocr review --format json`` document into our schema."""
    78	    comments = ocr_result.get("comments") or []
    79	    findings = [_rewrite_comment(c, i + 1) for i, c in enumerate(comments)]
    80	    return {
    81	        "review_type": review_type,
    82	        "target": change_id,
    83	        "reviewer_vendor": "ocr",
    84	        "findings": findings,
    85	    }
    86	
    87	
    88	class OcrRunError(RuntimeError):
    89	    """Raised when ``ocr review`` fails to produce a readable result."""
    90	
    91	
    92	def run_ocr(cwd: Path, *, timeout_seconds: int = 900) -> dict[str, Any]:
    93	    """Run ``ocr review`` over *cwd* and return its parsed JSON result.
    94	
    95	    Workspace mode by default (matches the diff every other vendor reviews
    96	    from the packet, since OCR runs in the same worktree before any round's
    97	    fix commit). ``REVIEW_BASE_REF``/``REVIEW_HEAD_REF`` env vars switch to
    98	    range mode when both are set.
    99	    """
   100	    # A directory, not mkstemp: mkstemp pre-creates the file itself, which
   101	    # would defeat the "ocr never wrote it" check below (the file would
   102	    # already exist, just empty, on every failure path).
   103	    tmp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="ocr-review-")
   104	    output_path = Path(tmp_dir) / "result.json"
   105	    try:
   106	        cmd = [
   107	            "ocr", "review", "--format", "json", "--audience", "agent",
   108	            "--output", str(output_path),
   109	        ]
   110	        from_ref = os.environ.get("REVIEW_BASE_REF")
   111	        to_ref = os.environ.get("REVIEW_HEAD_REF")
   112	        if from_ref and to_ref:
   113	            cmd.extend(["--from", from_ref, "--to", to_ref])
   114	        result = subprocess.run(
   115	            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout_seconds,
   116	            cwd=str(cwd),
   117	        )
   118	        if result.returncode != 0 and not output_path.exists():
   119	            raise OcrRunError(
   120	                f"ocr review exited {result.returncode}: {result.stderr[:500]}"
   121	            )
   122	        text = output_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
   123	        if not text.strip():
   124	            raise OcrRunError("ocr review produced an empty output file")
   125	        return json.loads(text)
   126	    finally:
   127	        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
   128	
   129	
   130	def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
   131	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
   132	    parser.add_argument(
   133	        "--change-id", default=os.environ.get("OCR_CHANGE_ID", "unknown"),
   134	    )
   135	    parser.add_argument(
   136	        "--review-type", default=os.environ.get("OCR_REVIEW_TYPE", "implementation"),
   137	    )
   138	    parser.add_argument("--repo", default=".")
   139	    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
   140	
   141	    # Consume and discard stdin (the review packet body): OCR reads the diff
   142	    # itself and does not need a pre-built packet.
   143	    if not sys.stdin.isatty():
   144	        try:
   145	            sys.stdin.read()
   146	        except (OSError, ValueError):
   147	            pass
   148	
   149	    if shutil.which("ocr") is None:
   150	        print("ocr: binary not found on PATH", file=sys.stderr)
   151	        return 2
   152	    if not ocr_configured():
   153	        print(
   154	            "ocr: no LLM endpoint configured "
   155	            "(OCR_LLM_URL/OCR_LLM_TOKEN unset, no ~/.opencodereview/config.json)",
   156	            file=sys.stderr,
   157	        )
   158	        return 2
   159	
   160	    try:
   161	        ocr_result = run_ocr(Path(args.repo))
   162	    except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, OcrRunError, json.JSONDecodeError, OSError) as exc:
   163	        print(f"ocr: review failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
   164	        return 1

   721	def dispatch_phase(
   722	    payload: PhaseDispatchPayload,
   723	    *,
   724	    runner: ProviderRunner | None = None,
   725	    dry_run: bool = False,
   726	    rate_limit_reporter: Callable[[PhaseDispatchResult], Any] = (
   727	        report_vendor_limit_result
   728	    ),
   729	) -> PhaseDispatchResult:
   730	    """Dispatch a phase payload through a provider adapter.
   731	
   732	    Production harnesses can pass *runner* to invoke their provider-specific
   733	    execution surface. Without a runner, unsupported/nonconfigured adapters
   734	    return a structured fallback result so the SKILL.md layer can continue
   735	    through inline execution. Terminal capacity reporting is best effort and
   736	    never replaces the dispatch result.
   737	    """
   738	    if dry_run:
   739	        result = _dry_run_result(payload)
   740	    elif payload.provider not in _SUPPORTED_PROVIDERS:
   741	        result = _fallback_result(
   742	            payload, f"adapter unavailable for provider {payload.provider!r}"
   743	        )
   744	    elif runner is None:
   745	        if payload.provider == _LOCAL_PROVIDER:
   746	            result = _dispatch_local(payload)
   747	        else:
   748	            result = _fallback_result(
   749	                payload,
   750	                f"adapter unavailable for provider {payload.provider!r} in this runtime",
   751	            )
   752	    else:
   753	        result = normalize_dispatch_result(runner(payload), payload, "harness")
   754	
   755	    _report_terminal_capacity(result, rate_limit_reporter)
   756	    return result
